guion: Part two of the army heist. He's driving their own Humvee, and the army sends more Humvees to take it back. Along the fence, through the mud, past a soldier on foot, and they're right on him. Both sides drive the same truck, built for exactly this kind of ground, so nobody pulls away. Then the swamp settles it: he plows straight into the mangroves. Was a Humvee the right getaway car, or the dumbest?
